title: Katana
summary: Versatile +1 longsword with three weapon actions.

fields.Damage: One hand: 1d8 + 1 Slashing. Two hands: 1d10 + 1 Slashing. Add Strength to damage and +1 to attack rolls.
fields.Handling: Martial melee weapon, 5 ft reach. Dippable.
fields.Acquisition: On a table in Golbraith’s Cellar. The Circus display is decorative.
fields.Base value: 55 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Flourish: With proficiency, Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. A Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Off Balance for 2 turns.
fields.Lacerate: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee attack for weapon damage. A Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Bleeding for 2 turns. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
fields.Rush Attack: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Charge up to 30 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks and hit the first non-allied creature or object in the path for 1d4 + Strength modifier Piercing. A Strength save against weapon-action DC prevents Off Balance for 2 turns.
